verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that gives agents inboxes via API, MCP, and CLI. A SaaS product of this kind could plausibly offer built-in AI insights, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. Keyword full-text search is not AI insight, and the LangChain vector-store loader is a developer building block that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
